title: Stochastic Calculus as Operator Factorization An Operator-Covariant Derivative and Unified Representation
summary: We present a unified operator-theoretic framework for stochastic calculus based on the factorization (Id - E)F = δ_X Π_X D_X F, valid for F_T^X-measurable F in L^2(Ω) when the driving process X has the representation property. For a square-integrable process X with stochastic integral δ_X, we define the operator-covariant derivative D_X := δ_X* as the Hilbert space adjoint of δ_X. Combined with predictable projection Π_X, this yields a unified Clark-Ocone representation.
